translations.text: I long to see you, remembering your tears, so that I may be filled with joy.
Take as your pattern the sound words you heard from me, in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he often gave me relief and was not ashamed of my chains.
May the Lord grant him mercy before the Lord on that day. And you know very well everything he did for me in Ephesus.
Furthermore, if someone competes in an athletic contest, he does not receive a crown unless he competes properly.
So if someone cleanses himself of these things, he will be a vessel for honorable use, purified and useful to the Lord, ready for every good work.
Flee youthful desires. Instead, pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, together with everyone who calls on our Lord from a pure heart.
Traitors, reckless and arrogant, loving pleasure more than loving God.
But you must remain sober in everything, endure hardship, do the work of a preacher of the good news, and fulfill your ministry.
The Lord will rescue me from every evil deed and bring me safely into his kingdom in heaven. To him be glory forever and ever. Amen.
Do your best to come to me before winter. Eubulus greets you, along with Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
